ref: #2 §2: "Structure fields with n = minOccurs = maxOccurs > 0 are generated automatically, n times, whatever the mapping" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_em900/helpdata/en/4b/f414f7eaca4c86e10000000a42189e/content.htm] [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bf414f7eaca4c86e10000000a42189e.html]; #2 §1 nested queues: "The number of contexts of a queue must be the same as the number of values (empty strings) of the upper-level queue", and a structure field's queue holds one empty string per occurrence [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_em900/helpdata/en/4b/fbd21666d33de4e10000000a42189e/content.htm]
note: Item per Id in context Orders: o1, o3, slot numbers 1, 2. Twin (2..2) is unmapped and created twice under each Item; the j-th Twin under Item slot p has slot number (p - 1) * 2 + j: 1, 2 under Item 1 and 3, 4 under Item 2. Qty in its default context Line: 1 | 2 | (empty), one context per Line across all Orders. So Item 1's Twins get 1 and 2, Item 2's first Twin reads the empty context 3 and its second the missing context 4. Info (1..1) is created once per Item, empty. Giving every Twin its Item's slot number would give Qty 1 in both Twins of Item 1 and 2 in both of Item 2.
